title: Golden and Evil Corpus v0 (kernel robustness, boolean operations)
generated_by: parity/corpus/runner/corpus_runner.cpp --emit (closed forms in closed_forms.h; no kernel code is used to produce an expectation)
units: model units; every length in a recipe is final (already scaled/translated), so a recipe is exactly what the runner builds
success: a case is ok when the operation returns without exception or timeout and EVERY invariant in `expect` holds: empty/non-empty, ON_Brep::IsValid, IsSolid with outward orientation, a closed-manifold tessellation (the app's MeshBrepClosed), exact volume (VolumeOfSealedSolid, else Volume, else the closed mesh), exact area, centroid from the closed mesh, Euler characteristic V-E+F-inner loops and shell count of the B-rep

tolerance_policy.planar_only: volume/area relative 1e-8, centroid 1e-6 of the result size (exact arithmetic)
tolerance_policy.curved: gross-correctness gate: volume and area relative 2e-2, centroid 5e-3 of the result size; the kernel's own exact integrals polygonize circular trims (a plain cylinder measures 3.8e-3 low), so tighter gates would score the integrator; the measured error of every case is recorded and the precision ladder 1e-2/1e-3/1e-4/1e-6 is tabulated from the same run
tolerance_policy.volume_abs: 1e-9 of the bounding volume: below it a volume is numerically zero
tolerance_policy.far_origin: volume/area relative widened to 160 eps D/L (divergence-theorem noise floor about the world origin)
tolerance_policy.ambiguity: |delta| <= 1e-6 (the kernel model tolerance): merged and separated topologies are both listed as allowed; empty may be 'either'

operand_kinds: box (optional rot), cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, prism - built as the app builds them (ON_BrepBox, ON_BrepCylinder, ON_BrepCone, ON_BrepSphere, ON_BrepTorus, trimmed plane + extrude); the seam of a round primitive is on the world x axis projected perpendicular to its axis
operations: boolean: steps of union/intersection/difference over groups of operand ids (N-ary folds as BooleanCombine*NAry), engine 'auto' = the app's order (planar engine, then general engine + kernel sealing, then plain sewing); measure: no operation, the operand itself is checked
